remarks.text:
gpt luna max vs claude fable ultracode 

sent "pls build a mostly faithful clone of grok imagine with open models via fal"

i woke up to these two and assumed fable was left and luna was right

i was wrong... it was the other way!!

objectively, fable did the better visual clone. but luna somehow understood intent better and created the more USABLE clone given my open model bent.
remarks.translation: gpt luna max 对比 claude fable ultracode 发送了“请用开放模型通过 fal 构建一个基本忠实的 grok imagine 克隆”。我醒来看到这两个，以为 fable 在左边，luna 在右边，我错了……其实是反过来的！！客观来说，fable 在视觉克隆上做得更好。但 luna 不知怎么更理解意图，考虑到我对开放模型的偏好，它创建了更实用的克隆。

remarks.name: Guillermo Rauch
remarks.role: vercel CEO
remarks.text:
Vercel Sandbox isolates both ① compute and ② network.

Kimi's paper shows container-based isolation is not enough for frontier models. Vercel Sandbox uses strong microVM isolation to address ①.

OpenAI's escape was on ② the network path to Artifactory. Our egress firewall is now free so everyone can constrain misbehaving agents' network activity further.

¹ "in our early experiments with traditional container-based sandbox runtimes, we observed several kernel
panics and deadlocks caused by unintended agent operations." 
🔗 github⁠.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3/blob/master/k3_tech_report.pdf

² "to gain Internet access, the models identified and exploited a previously unknown zero-day vulnerability in Artifactory⁠, a package registry cache proxy"
🔗 openai⁠.com/index/hugging-face-model-evaluation-security-incident/
remarks.translation: Vercel Sandbox 同时隔离了 ① 计算环境与 ② 网络环境。Kimi 的论文表明，基于容器的隔离对于前沿模型而言并不足够。Vercel Sandbox 采用强力的微虚拟机隔离来应对 ① 计算隔离问题。OpenAI 的逃逸事件则发生在通往 Artifactory 的 ② 网络路径上。我们的出站防火墙现已免费开放，以便大家进一步约束行为异常的智能体的网络活动。¹ “在我们早期使用传统容器沙箱运行环境的实验中，我们观察到多次由非预期的智能体操作引发的内核崩溃与死锁。” 🔗 github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K3/blob/master/k3_tech_report.pdf ² “为了获取互联网访问权限，这些模型识别并利用了 Artifactory（一个软件包注册表缓存代理）中一个此前未知的零日漏洞” 🔗 openai.com/index/hugging-face-model-evaluation-security-incident/

remarks.name: Madhu Guru
remarks.role: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
remarks.text:
been deep down this rabbit hole at the intersection of AI and consumer experiences recently:

How do you develop a theory of why someone did something, rather than just a history of what they did?

Consumer products have a mix of explicit signals from search/chat and implicit signals from what you watch, skip, linger on, revisit.

understanding what those signals actually mean requires reasoning about context - what’s happening in someone’s life, what’s happening in the world, and how their interests are evolving over time.

and doing this in a near real-time manner for billion user consumer experiences is a whole other challenge.
remarks.translation: 最近我深陷于AI与消费者体验交叉领域的探索：如何构建一套理论来解释用户行为背后的动机，而非仅仅记录其行为轨迹？消费类产品既包含搜索/聊天产生的显性信号，也包含观看、跳过、停留、回访等行为留下的隐性信号。要真正理解这些信号的含义，需要结合情境进行推理——用户生活中正在发生什么，外部世界正在发生什么，以及他们的兴趣如何随时间演变。而要在近实时状态下为数十亿用户规模的消费体验实现这一点，则是完全不同的挑战。

remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
Meta releasing Muse Spark 1.2 as open weights is a *very* big deal. America now finally has its response to the open weights AI race. 

This will continue to help drive down the cost of intelligence, it allows companies to run models as they see fit, as well as allows them to post train their own models for specific use-cases to get better performance gains in their domain. And provides a realistic option for those previously closed off from OSS models.

This is broadly net positive for AI - even frontier closed models - because it helps drive further diffusion of AI. Big moment in the AI race.
remarks.translation: Meta以开放权重发布Muse Spark 1.2，这是一件*非常*重大的事。美国如今终于有了对开放权重AI竞赛的回应。这将持续推动智能成本的下降，使企业能够按需运行模型，并允许它们针对特定用例进行后训练，从而在各自领域获得更好的性能提升。同时，这也为那些此前被排除在开源模型之外的人提供了一个现实的选择。总体而言，这对AI——甚至包括前沿封闭模型——都是净利好，因为它有助于推动AI的进一步普及。这是AI竞赛中的一个重要时刻。

remarks.text:
A great way to learn design:
Give Codex a well-designed website, ask it to analyze what makes the design great, then ask it to take a complete screenshot of the website & add annotations on the image that breaks down why the design works

Learning from examples is always better than learning from theory!

And using the annotation method means you don't have to constantly switch between reading the analysis and viewing the artifact
remarks.translation: 学习设计的一个好方法：给Codex一个设计精良的网站，让它分析设计的亮点所在，然后请它截取网站的完整截图，并在图片上添加注释，解析设计为何有效。从实例中学习总是比从理论中学习更好！而且使用注释法意味着你无需在阅读分析和查看作品之间频繁切换。
